story_title: Lina and Adams and the Big and Small Walk
title: Lina and Adams and the Big and Small Walk 🌳 | English Opposites for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Go on a forest walk with Lina, Adams and Milo and discover big and small things! 🌳🐜🎈
In this English story for kids, children learn 7 new words — opposites: big, small, tall, short, fast, up and down. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
📏 big — كبير — grand
🐜 small — صغير — petit
🌳 tall — طويل — grand / haut
🌱 short — قصير — court / petit
🐇 fast — سريع — rapide
⬆️ up — فوق / إلى الأعلى — en haut
⬇️ down — تحت / إلى الأسفل — en bas

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: find big and small things at home and play the opposites game together. Pause after each new word and say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصة باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم الأضداد: كبير وصغير، طويل وقصير.
🇫🇷 Une histoire en anglais pour enfants pour apprendre les contraires : grand et petit, en haut et en bas.

lines.text: It is a bright morning. Lina and Adams are in the garden.
Look, Adams! I have a balloon. It is so big!
Wow! Your balloon is bigger than my head!
Milo the cat looks up at the balloon. Meow!
When something is very large, we say it is big.
Say it with me: big!
Let's go for a walk in the forest and find more big things!
Lina, Adams and Milo walk into the green forest.
Lina, come here! Look at this tiny little ant.
Oh, it is so small! It is carrying a crumb.
When something is very little, we say it is small.
Can you say it? Small!
The balloon is big. The ant is small. Big and small!
Big and small are opposites. They are very different.
Now Lina and Adams look up, up, up.
This tree is so tall! It touches the clouds!
I can see a bird at the top. Tweet, tweet!
When something goes very high from the ground, we say it is tall.
Say it with me: tall!
I want to be tall like this tree one day!
You are growing every day, Adams!
Next to the tall tree, there is a little bush.
This bush is short. It only comes to my knee!
Milo is short too. He is the same size as the bush!
Milo hides in the bush. Meow! Can you see me?
When something is not tall, we say it is short.
Can you say it? Short!
Tall tree, short bush. Tall and short!
They walk out of the forest and into the park.
A little dog runs past them. Zoom!
Look at that dog! He runs so fast!
Milo, can you run fast too?
Milo runs after the dog. Zoom, zoom! He is very fast.
When something moves very quickly, we say it is fast.
Say it with me: fast!
Whoosh! The wind blows, and Lina's balloon slips from her hand.
Oh no! My balloon is going up!
It is going up, up, up into the sky!
When something goes higher and higher, we say it goes up.
Let's point to the sky and say: up!
My big balloon. I am a little bit sad.
Don't worry, Lina. Let's look for it together.
Lina and Adams walk and look. Where is the balloon?
There it is! It is stuck in a tall tree!
It is too high. We are too short to reach it.
Milo looks at the tree. He has an idea. Meow!
Milo climbs up the tree, slowly and carefully.
Be careful, Milo!
Milo gently taps the balloon string with his paw.
The balloon floats down, down, down, into Lina's hands.
Hooray! My balloon came down!
When something goes lower and lower, we say it goes down.
Let's point to the ground and say: down!
Then Milo climbs down the tree too. Down, down, down.
Thank you, Milo! You are small, but you are very brave!
Meow! Purr, purr.
Now Lina ties the balloon string around her wrist.
Now my balloon cannot fly away.
Let's play the opposites game, Lina!
I say big, and you say...
Small! Now I say tall, and you say...
Short! I say up, and you say...
Down! I say fast, and Milo says... Meow!
Lina and Adams laugh and laugh.
In the evening, they walk back home to the garden.
The sun goes down, and the sky turns orange and pink.
Today we saw a big balloon and a small ant.
We saw a tall tree and a short bush.
We saw a fast dog. And the balloon went up and down!
Milo drinks some milk from his cup. Lap, lap, lap.
Milo, you were our hero today!
At night, the balloon is tied to Lina's bed.
The moon is up in the sky, and the stars are shining.
Good night, big balloon.
Good night, small Milo.
Milo curls up on the bed. Purr, purr.
Good night, everyone! See you tomorrow!
And Lina and Adams close their eyes. Good night!
